_README: Copy this file to scripts/seed.config.json and fill it in.
HOW TO GET A DOCTOR UID:
1. Firebase Console -> Authentication -> Users -> Add user
2. Enter the doctor's email and a password
3. Copy the 'User UID' column value (28 characters)
4. Paste it as 'uid' below, with the same email
This script never creates Auth accounts and never handles passwords.
Both the app (roleService.resolveRole) and firestore.rules ask the
same question: does a document exist at doctors/{authUid}? So a
doctor's Firestore document ID must BE their Auth UID. A 'uid'
field on a differently-keyed document is not enough - the rules
Two of your existing doctor records use auto-generated IDs, so the
script re-keys them: it creates doctors/{uid} with their data and
marks the old document unavailable rather than deleting anything.
